scripts.check: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.checks.json --noEmit && node scripts/check-schema.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-copy.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.checks.json && node scripts/prepare-checks.mjs && node --test .cache/checks/checks/*.test.js
scripts.build: npm run build:art && npm run validate:content && npm run check && npm run build:server && vite build && node scripts/prepare-client.mjs
scripts.eval:coach: tsc -p tsconfig.checks.json && node scripts/prepare-checks.mjs && node evaluation/evaluate.mjs
